posts.angle: Getting a headcount your caterer will actually accept
posts.caption:
Caterers usually ask for the final headcount two weeks before the wedding, but guests always reply late.

When you look at a live RSVP site, you notice the headcount shifts right up until the last day. Guests add their plus-ones or suddenly mention fish allergies kasi they forgot earlier.

Having a live link means your caterer gets exact numbers without you texting twenty people at midnight. Try a demo at anyayadesigns.github.io/flow.

posts.subject: craft
posts.angle: Show us your motif and we will guess your paper
posts.caption:
"I want a sage green motif, so which paper stock fits best," a bride asked us yesterday. Soft earth tones and greens belong on our 300gsm textured cotton craft paper kasi the subtle weave absorbs matte inks without bleeding. Deep jewel tones work better on smooth kraft cardstock to keep the contrast sharp when held in hand. Send us your motif colors and we will tell you which paper stock fits, complete with a small QR code printed on the back for your live RSVP website.
